about: Annotated examples of atlas.json sprite entries (one per attachment style). Not a pack — the build ignores this folder. Copy, then change rect / anchor / points to match your PNG.

examples._note: Draw it facing RIGHT, rising at about 40°. anchor = the petiole's first pixel (it touches the stem). The build bakes the left twin. pigment mask: a 12×12 rect at (54, 61) — opaque pixels there take the pigment; toothed mask at (68, 61) — opaque pixels there are CUT when Salt is owned.
Upright. anchor = the bottom pixel of the stalk, which sits on the apex (or on the tip of the flower branch when a seed head holds the apex).
Hangs DOWN from its anchor (the top-centre pixel), drawn over the procedural primary root.
A faceted crystal that sits ON a leaf point (the selector puts it on every leaf tip): anchor = its bottom pixel, which lands exactly on the point. Must read as a crystal / deposit, never as frost.
Leaves the stem's RIGHT edge 9 rows above the soil (anchor = top-left pixel) and arches down-outward; its bottom row must reach soil row 68 (≥ 10 rows tall). The build bakes the left twin.
